record.question: I asked him where he was going.
record.explanation: Answer A: Noun clause. “Where he was going” is the object/content of “asked”; noun clause. Independent check: “Where he was going” is the embedded question serving as the object of “asked,” traditionally a noun clause. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
